backendBinary.title: Backend {backends}: the {cmd} CLI was not found
backendBinary.description: Timon cannot run {cmd} on this machine, so every mission on {backends} fails as soon as it starts.
backendBinary.repairPinned: Action needed: The path pinned for {cmd} ({configKey}) does not point to an executable file. Fix it in {settings}, or clear it to let Timon look for the CLI itself.
backendBinary.repairMissing: Action needed: Install it, then click {recheck} in {settings} — or pin the full path of the {cmd} binary there ({configKey}).
